checks.name: Locale parity and nonempty messages
Project role membership is isolated by project
Empty and duplicate project names validate only on save
Project save failure retains draft and creates no project; retry opens empty project
Switching projects preserves independent existing drafts and records
Project navigation cancels pending job and prevents late creation
Project maintainer cannot create projects or alter team roles
Viewer mutations are denied and invitation action is disabled
Member role changes keep other project membership unchanged
Last maintainer cannot be demoted or removed from project or team
Owner/self and peer admins are protected
Project removal needs inline confirmation and preserves other project access/history
Team removal revokes pending invites but preserves history
Invalid email, existing member and duplicate active invitation are rejected
Invitation creation freezes scope, normalizes email and blocks duplicate submission
Invitation save failure creates no invite and keeps email for retry
Unverified, wrong and signed-out recipients cannot accept
Accept failure and retry are independent of email delivery
Expired and revoked invitations cannot be accepted
Expiry during acceptance prevents late membership
Replacement invalidates old invitation and maintains only one active invite
Acceptance adds project access to existing team member without overwriting team role
Invitation does not overwrite a membership added before acceptance
Project maintainer cannot invite into another project or grant team admin
Drafts survive language switch and are scoped by project
Rendered labels are escaped and all invitation statuses have translated messages
Role selection cannot bypass removal confirmation
Failed member removal retains access and permits explicit retry
Project maintainer cannot revoke or replace another project invitation
Project maintainer cannot replace an invitation granting team administrator access
